chapterInfo.content:
20
Nsɛm a ɛsisii wɔ Kades
1 # Num 13.21 Na Israelfoɔ asafo mu no nyinaa baa Sin serɛ so, bosome a ɛdi kan no mu, na ɔman no tenaa Kades; na Miriam wuu wɔ hɔ, na wɔsiee no hɔ ara.
2 # Eks 17.1-7 Na nsuo nni hɔ mma asafo no, na wɔhyia tiaa Mose ne Aaron. 3Na ɔman no ne Mose hamee, na wɔkaa sɛ: Ɛkaa yɛn nko a, anka ɛberɛ a yɛn nuanom wuwuu AWURADE anim no yɛwuwuu bi. 4Na adɛn nti na mode AWURADE man aba ɛserɛ yi so sɛ yɛmmɛwuwu wɔ ha, yɛn ne yɛn mmoa? 5Na adɛn nti na moyii yɛn Misraim sɛ mode yɛn reba deɛ ɛnyɛ yi, deɛ wɔntumi nnua hwee a borɔdɔma ne bobe ne atoaa nnie, na nsuo mpo a wɔnom nnie yi? 6#Num 14.10 Na Mose ne Aaron firii asafo no anim baa ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na wɔde wɔn anim butubutuu fam; na AWURADE animuonyam yii ne ho kyerɛɛ wɔn.
7Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 8Fa poma no na boa asafo no ano, wo ne wo nua Aaron, na monkasa nkyerɛ ɔbotan no wɔn anim, na ɛmma ne nsuo, na yi ɔbotan no mu nsuo ma wɔn ma asafo no ne wɔn mmoa nnom. 9Na Mose faa poma no firii AWURADE anim, sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ no no; 10#Dwom 106.33 na Mose ne Aaron boaboaa ɔman asafo no ano ɔbotan no anim, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Montie ɛ, mo asoɔdenfoɔ, adɛn ɛsɛ sɛ yɛnya nsuo firi ɔbotan yi mu ma mo anaa? 11Na Mose maa ne nsa so de ne poma no bɔɔ ɔbotan no mprenu, na nsuo pii firi mu bae, na asafo no ne wɔn mmoa nomee. 12#Num 27.14; Deut 1.37; 3.26; 4.21; 32.51 Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ: Sɛ moannye me annie na moanyɛ me kronkron Israelfoɔ anim nti, moremfa ɔman asafo yi nnuru asase a mede mama wɔn no so. 13#Dwom 81.7 Yei ne Meriba#20.13 MERIBA: Asekyerɛ ne: Ɔham. asuo, ɛfiri sɛ Israelfoɔ ne AWURADE hamee na ɔyɛɛ ne ho kronkron wɔn mu.
Edomfoɔ si Mose kwan
14 # Gye 32.3; Ate 11.17; Deut 23.7 Na Mose somaa abɔfoɔ firi Kades kɔɔ Edomhene nkyɛn sɛ: Sɛ wo nua Israel seɛ nie: Wo ara wonim ɔhaw a ɛtoo yɛn nyinaa, 15sɛ yɛn nananom siane kɔɔ Misraim, na yɛtenaa Misraim nna bebree, na Misraimfoɔ yɛɛ yɛn ne yɛn nananom bɔne; 16#Eks 23.20 na yɛsu frɛɛ AWURADE, na ɔtee yɛn nne, na ɔsomaa ɔbɔfoɔ maa no bɛyii yɛn firii Misraim; na hwɛ, yɛwɔ Kades, kuro a ɛwɔ wo hyeɛ soɔ mu. 17#Num 21.22 Ma yɛmfa w’asase so; yɛremfa mfuo ne nturo mu, nanso yɛrennom mmura mu nsuo bi; yɛbɛnante ɔhene tempɔn so akɔ, yɛremmane nifa anaa benkum de bɛkɔ akɔsi sɛ yɛbɛtwam w’asase soɔ. 18Na Edom ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mmɛfa me mu, na mamfa nkrantɛ mamfiri adi mammɛhyia wo. 19Na Israelfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Tempɔn so na yɛrebɛfa, na sɛ yɛn ne yɛn mmoa nom wo nsuo bi a, yɛbɛtua ka; ɛnyɛ asɛm biara, na yɛn nan nko ara na ma yɛmfa ntwam mu nkɔ 20Na wɔse: Mommɛtwam! Na Edom de dɔm pii ne nsa a emu yɛ den firii adi bɛhyiaa wɔn. 21Na Edom kamee Israel ɔkwan a wɔde bɛtwam n’asase soɔ. Enti Israel mane firii ne ho.
22Na Israelfoɔ asafo mu no nyinaa tu firii Kades, na wɔbaa Hor bepɔ ho. 23Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron Hor bepɔ ho, Edom asase hyeɛ so, sɛ: 24Aka kakraa bi na Aaron ati ne mpanimfoɔ wɔ asamando, na ɔrenkɔ asase a mede merema Israelfoɔ no so, ɛfiri sɛ moyɛɛ asoɔden maa m’anomu asɛm Meriba asuo ho. 25Fa Aaron ne ne ba Eleasa, na wo ne wɔn mforo Hor bepɔ, 26#Lew 21.10 na yi Aaron ntadeɛ no fa hyɛ ne ba Eleasa, na ɔnwu wɔ hɔ nti ne mpanimfoɔ wɔ asamando. 27Na Mose yɛɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ no no, na wɔforoo Hor bepɔ, asafo no nyinaa anim. 28#Num 33.38; Deut 10.6 Na Mose yiyii Aaron ntadeɛ no de hyɛɛ ne ba Eleasa, na Aaron wuu wɔ bepɔ no atifi hɔ. Na Mose ne Eleasa firii bepɔ no so sianee. 29Na asafo no nyinaa hunuu sɛ Aaron awuo no, Israel fie nyinaa suu no adaduasa.

Na Israelfoɔ asafo mu no nyinaa baa Sin serɛ so, bosome a ɛdi kan no mu, na ɔman no tenaa Kades; na Miriam wuu wɔ hɔ, na wɔsiee no hɔ ara.
Na nsuo nni hɔ mma asafo no, na wɔhyia tiaa Mose ne Aaron. Na ɔman no ne Mose hamee, na wɔkaa sɛ: Ɛkaa yɛn nko a, anka ɛberɛ a yɛn nuanom wuwuu AWURADE anim no yɛwuwuu bi. Na adɛn nti na mode AWURADE man aba ɛserɛ yi so sɛ yɛmmɛwuwu wɔ ha, yɛn ne yɛn mmoa? Na adɛn nti na moyii yɛn Misraim sɛ mode yɛn reba deɛ ɛnyɛ yi, deɛ wɔntumi nnua hwee a borɔdɔma ne bobe ne atoaa nnie, na nsuo mpo a wɔnom nnie yi? Na Mose ne Aaron firii asafo no anim baa ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na wɔde wɔn anim butubutuu fam; na AWURADE animuonyam yii ne ho kyerɛɛ wɔn.
Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Fa poma no na boa asafo no ano, wo ne wo nua Aaron, na monkasa nkyerɛ ɔbotan no wɔn anim, na ɛmma ne nsuo, na yi ɔbotan no mu nsuo ma wɔn ma asafo no ne wɔn mmoa nnom. Na Mose faa poma no firii AWURADE anim, sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ no no; na Mose ne Aaron boaboaa ɔman asafo no ano ɔbotan no anim, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Montie ɛ, mo asoɔdenfoɔ, adɛn ɛsɛ sɛ yɛnya nsuo firi ɔbotan yi mu ma mo anaa? Na Mose maa ne nsa so de ne poma no bɔɔ ɔbotan no mprenu, na nsuo pii firi mu bae, na asafo no ne wɔn mmoa nomee. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ: Sɛ moannye me annie na moanyɛ me kronkron Israelfoɔ anim nti, moremfa ɔman asafo yi nnuru asase a mede mama wɔn no so. Yei ne Meriba asuo, ɛfiri sɛ Israelfoɔ ne AWURADE hamee na ɔyɛɛ ne ho kronkron wɔn mu.

Na Mose somaa abɔfoɔ firi Kades kɔɔ Edomhene nkyɛn sɛ: Sɛ wo nua Israel seɛ nie: Wo ara wonim ɔhaw a ɛtoo yɛn nyinaa, sɛ yɛn nananom siane kɔɔ Misraim, na yɛtenaa Misraim nna bebree, na Misraimfoɔ yɛɛ yɛn ne yɛn nananom bɔne; na yɛsu frɛɛ AWURADE, na ɔtee yɛn nne, na ɔsomaa ɔbɔfoɔ maa no bɛyii yɛn firii Misraim; na hwɛ, yɛwɔ Kades, kuro a ɛwɔ wo hyeɛ soɔ mu. Ma yɛmfa w’asase so; yɛremfa mfuo ne nturo mu, nanso yɛrennom mmura mu nsuo bi; yɛbɛnante ɔhene tempɔn so akɔ, yɛremmane nifa anaa benkum de bɛkɔ akɔsi sɛ yɛbɛtwam w’asase soɔ. Na Edom ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mmɛfa me mu, na mamfa nkrantɛ mamfiri adi mammɛhyia wo. Na Israelfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Tempɔn so na yɛrebɛfa, na sɛ yɛn ne yɛn mmoa nom wo nsuo bi a, yɛbɛtua ka; ɛnyɛ asɛm biara, na yɛn nan nko ara na ma yɛmfa ntwam mu nkɔ Na wɔse: Mommɛtwam! Na Edom de dɔm pii ne nsa a emu yɛ den firii adi bɛhyiaa wɔn. Na Edom kamee Israel ɔkwan a wɔde bɛtwam n’asase soɔ. Enti Israel mane firii ne ho.
Na Israelfoɔ asafo mu no nyinaa tu firii Kades, na wɔbaa Hor bepɔ ho. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron Hor bepɔ ho, Edom asase hyeɛ so, sɛ: Aka kakraa bi na Aaron ati ne mpanimfoɔ wɔ asamando, na ɔrenkɔ asase a mede merema Israelfoɔ no so, ɛfiri sɛ moyɛɛ asoɔden maa m’anomu asɛm Meriba asuo ho. Fa Aaron ne ne ba Eleasa, na wo ne wɔn mforo Hor bepɔ, na yi Aaron ntadeɛ no fa hyɛ ne ba Eleasa, na ɔnwu wɔ hɔ nti ne mpanimfoɔ wɔ asamando. Na Mose yɛɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ no no, na wɔforoo Hor bepɔ, asafo no nyinaa anim. Na Mose yiyii Aaron ntadeɛ no de hyɛɛ ne ba Eleasa, na Aaron wuu wɔ bepɔ no atifi hɔ. Na Mose ne Eleasa firii bepɔ no so sianee. Na asafo no nyinaa hunuu sɛ Aaron awuo no, Israel fie nyinaa suu no adaduasa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
